title: How can you be kind online?
examples: How can I be kind online?
What should I think about before I post?

explain.say: Here is a surprising thing: words online can hurt just as much as words said out loud, and they can last for years. Before you post, try a simple word: THINK. Look at the first letter on the board: T, is it true?

explain.say: H asks, is it helpful? And I asks, is it inspiring, which means does it make people feel good or want to do well? Can you think of a post that is both?

steps.label: K: Is it kind?
steps.note: Would I say it face to face?
steps.ask: Would I say it face to face?

explain.say: N asks, is it necessary? Does it really need saying? And look at the heart: K, is it kind? Would I say this to their face? If not, do not post it. How many letters can you remember?

explain.say: Now look at what kind online looks like: great video! Helpful tips, including others in a chat, and asking before you post a photo of someone. Small acts, big difference.
Unkind online means mean comments, sharing secrets, leaving people out of chats, or posting photos without asking. Great work! Challenge: leave one kind comment for someone this week.

faq.q: Would I say it face to face?
faq.a: This is a great test before posting. If you would not say it to the person's face, with a grown-up listening, do not post it.
asks: Tell me about the K: Is it kind?

faq.q: What does THINK before you post mean?
faq.a: It is a check: is it True, Helpful, Inspiring, Necessary and Kind? If a post fails, change it or do not post it.
asks: Tell me about the T: Is it true?

faq.q: Is it okay to share a funny photo of my friend?
faq.a: Ask first. Something you find funny might embarrass them. Once a photo is shared, it is very hard to delete everywhere.
asks: Tell me about the Posting photos

faq.q: What if people in my group chat are being mean?
faq.a: Do not join in. You can say: Not cool, guys. Leave the chat if you need to, save the messages and tell a trusted adult.
asks: Tell me about the Mean comments

faq.q: Why do people act meaner online?
faq.a: Behind a screen, people cannot see faces or tears, and some feel hidden, so they forget there is a real person reading. Remembering that helps.
asks: Why are people so mean online?

facts: Safer Internet Day is celebrated in February in more than 180 countries and territories.
Many popular apps require users to be at least 13 years old, partly because of a US children's privacy law called COPPA.

quiz.say: What does the K in THINK stand for?
quiz.why: K asks: is it kind? Would I say it face to face?

wrong.1: Keep is not one of the THINK words.
wrong.2: Know is not one of the THINK words.

quiz.say: You took a funny photo of your friend. What should you do before posting it?

options.show: Ask your friend if it is okay
options.say: Ask your friend if it is okay

quiz.why: Asking first respects your friend's feelings and privacy.

wrong.0: It might embarrass them, and it is hard to delete.
